user.title: Family Today
user.description: Choose the calendars to combine into one 'today' view.

people.title: Who owns each calendar?
people.description: One line per calendar: `calendar.entity = Person`. Edit the names as you like. {error}

abort.already_configured: Family Today is already set up.

school.title: School terms
school.description: Pick a school calendar (e.g. an ICS feed of term dates) or enter terms manually; manual terms are the fallback. Manual terms: one per line, `2026-11-02 to 2026-12-18 Autumn 2`. INSET days: dates separated by commas or new lines. Calendar events whose title contains a break keyword (holiday, inset...) are non-school days; events containing a term keyword span a term. {error}

data.school_break_keywords: Break keywords (default: holiday, half term, inset, closed, break...)

bins.title: Bin collections
bins.description: Pick a Waste Collection Schedule calendar, or use manual rules. Aliases: `Refuse = General waste`. Manual rules: `General waste | thu | 2 | 2026-11-12` (name, weekday, every N weeks, a known collection date). Moves: `2026-12-24 -> 2026-12-23` or `-> skip`. {error}

error.invalid_bins: Check the manual bin rule lines.
